evaluation.final_reason: Multiple participants converged on the same basic solution (a shared weeknight rota plus immediate washing and splitting supplies) but not every concrete detail or assignment was completed by the end of the transcript. Evidence of agreement in principle: Agent D proposed the rota and washing ("Let’s use a shared sign-up rota for weeknight stove slots, and whoever cooks washes the pan right after."), Agent A agreed to try the rota with conditions ("I'll try the rota for a week if everyone washes pans immediately after use and we split the cost of shared supplies."), and Agent B accepted rota and supplies ("Fine — rota and splitting supplies works."). Specific commitments were made for many nights: Agent D committed to Mon/Wed/Fri ("I'll take the late slots on Monday, Wednesday and Friday."), and Agent C took Tue/Thu ("I'll take Tuesday and Thursday."). What remained unsettled by the end: Agent A had not yet selected which night(s) they will take, and the final concrete structure (one-person-per-night vs early/late per night) was clarified but not completely recorded on the board. Thus the group reached partial agreement (who takes most nights and the principle of washing/ splitting)
